shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Hapana mushumo mutsva? PickupRadar inogona kuratidza {likelyFast} kana {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): nguva yekumirira kutora yevatyairi muUnited Kingdom

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Ona kuti vatyairi vanomirira nguva yakareba sei muzvitoro nezvokudya usati wapinda. Yevatyairi veUber Eats, Deliveroo neJust Eat muUnited Kingdom. Hapana kunyoresa.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Ziva nguva yekumirira usati wapinda.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Unotumira Uber Eats, Deliveroo kana Just Eat? Ona nguva itsva yekumirira panzvimbo dzekutora dzemaresitorendi nemaenzanisi. Dzivisa kumirira kureba. Baya {reportWait} uwane {radarPoints}. Hapana kunyoresa.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Maapp e iPhone neAndroid achauya munguva pfupi.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Muenzaniso wechikwangwani chemba chePickupRadar, tab {nearby} yakavhurwa. Nzvimbo dzekutora dzine mavara zvichienderana nenguva yekumirira

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Chikwangwani chemuenzaniso: nguva yekumirira yemuenzaniso, kwete mushumo wezvino wemutyairi

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Chikwangwani chemuenzaniso. Iyi nguva yekumirira yemuenzaniso, kwete mushumo wezvino. {live} neruzivo rwechokwadi.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Shandisa {nearby} kutsvaga nzvimbo dzekutora dziri pedyo newe kana nzvimbo yakabatidzwa. Shandisa {fast} ne{slow} kutarisa nguva dzekumirira nekufungidzira.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Edza zita, nharaunda kana kodhi yepositi, semuenzaniso KFC kana Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Chikwangwani {reportWait} chinovhurwa. Sarudza nguva yekumirira. Hapana chinotumirwa.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Unoona zviratidzo zvakafanana muapp. Vatyairi ndivo vanozvishuma, kwete app yekutumira.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Vatyairi vanosarudza nguva yekumirira. Unoona nguva yekumirira yazvino uye vatyairi vangani vakazvishuma mumaawa 2 apfuura.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Inoratidzwa chete kana pasina mushumo mutsva. Ichi kufungidzira, kwete mushumo wezvino.

home.signals.closed.pill.text: Yakashumwa nguva pfupi yapfuura kuti yakavharwa

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Vatyairi vanobaya {reportProblem} kuzvishuma. Unoona mushumo usati waenda ikoko.

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Matanho matatu akareruka. Kushuma kunotora masekondi mashoma.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Hapana password. App inokupa purofairi yeRadar yoga. Hauzodi kunyoresa.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Tsvaga nzvimbo yekutora. Ona nguva yekumirira yazvino, kana {likelyFast} kana {likelySlow} kana pasina mushumo mutsva.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Mushure mekutora odha, baya {reportWait}. Inotora masekondi mashoma. Mushumo wako unobatsira vamwe vatyairi, uye unowana {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Nzvimbo yekutora inokodzera iri pedyo newe, isina nguva itsva yekumirira, uye isina {likelyFast} kana {likelySlow}. Unowana 15 RP pamushumo uyu, kwete 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Aya maguta eUnited Kingdom ari muapp. Hausi kuona guta rako? Richikumbire muapp. Kana kubaya {notify} paguta riri {comingSoon}. Tinotumira email kana rava mhenyu.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Haisi chikamu cheapp yekutumira chero ipi

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar yakazvimiririra. Haisi chikamu cheUber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat kana imwe app yekutumira. Haishandisi akaundi yako ikoko.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Hatikumbiri zita kana password yeUber Eats, Deliveroo kana Just Eat.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Hapana zita, kero kana nhamba yeodha.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Kwete. App inokupa purofairi yeRadar yoga. Unogona kushuma nguva yekumirira pakarepo. Kuchengetedza {radarPoints}, wedzera email gare gare. Hapana password. App inotumira kodhi yenhamba 6 neemail.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Maapp e iPhone neAndroid achauya munguva pfupi. Parizvino, {preview} inoratidza nzvimbo dzekutora dzechokwadi nenguva yekumirira muMilton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Hapana kuteedzera kumashure. App inoshandisa nzvimbo yako paunoshandisa, kuratidza nzvimbo dzekutora dziri pedyo uye kuona kuti uri panzvimbo yekutora paunenge uchishuma. Saiti inokumbira nzvimbo chete kana wasarudza kuishandisa. Verenga {privacy} kuti uzive zvimwe.

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Edza app yePickupRadar neruzivo rwechokwadi rweMilton Keynes. Tarisa kutenderedza, tsvaga nzvimbo yekutora uye ona chikwangwani chemushumo.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Iyi ndiyo PickupRadar neruzivo rwechokwadi rweMilton Keynes. Tarisa kutenderedza. Tsvaga nzvimbo yekutora uivhure. Chausi kubaya pano hachitumirwi. Unogona kushuma muapp yefoni chete.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Kuona kuzere kweapp yePickupRadar neruzivo rwechokwadi rweMilton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Rubatsiro rwePickupRadar: bata rutsigiro, shuma dambudziko renzvimbo yekutora, uye tsvaga mhinduro nezve purofairi yeRadar, {radarPoints} nekudzima akaundi.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Unoda rubatsiro? Tumira email nezve app, nzvimbo yekutora, {radarPoints} kana zvakavanzika zvako.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Tumira email yerubatsiro, pfungwa, dambudziko renzvimbo yekutora kana mubvunzo wezvakavanzika:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Yetsamba chete. Email ndiyo nzira inokurumidza yekutibata.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Nharaunda kana kodhi yepositi, kana uchiziva

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Mhando yefoni yako, kana dambudziko riri muapp

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: App inokupa purofairi yeRadar yoga. Hauzodi kupinda kuti ushandise PickupRadar kana kuwana {radarPoints}. Kuwedzera email kuzvidira. Inochengetedza {radarPoints} kana ukachinja kana kudzoreredza foni. Hapana password. App inotumira kodhi yenhamba 6 neemail.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Unowana {radarPoints} pamushumo wekumirira wakakodzera ({waitRp}, kana {neededRp} kana {reportNeeded} yakanyorwa), bhonasi yemushumo wekutanga ({firstRp}) nenzvimbo yekutora yatakabvumira ({approvedRp}). Unogona kukoka mutyairi kubva ku{profile}. Mose munofanira kuva nemaakaundi eRadar akachengetedzwa (wedzera email). Shamwari yako inoisa kodhi yako mushumo wekutanga wekumirira wakakodzera usati waitwa. Shamwari yako painoita mishumo 3 yakakodzera yekumirira, pamazuva 2 akasiyana zvishoma (nguva yeUTC), panzvimbo 2 dzakasiyana dzekutora, mumwe nemumwe anowana {referralRp}. {rewards} Haugone kushandisa {radarPoints} parizvino.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} ine {messages}: zviziviso, yambiro nemameseji ega eguta rako kana purofairi yeRadar. Mameseji ekare kana akabviswa anogona kusazopindirazve.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Dzima akaundi muapp: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Kana kutumira email kuna {email}. Kana usina kuwedzera email, app inoratidza {deleteProfile}. Ona peji {page} kuti uzive nhanho.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Nzvimbo yekutora haisi ipapo? Baya {suggest} muapp. Pane chakakanganisa? Baya {reportProblem}. Kana kutitumira email, tichatarisa.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar haina kubatana neakaundi yako yeUber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat kana imwe app yekutumira. Hatikumbiri kupinda, password, ruzivo rweakaundi, ruzivo rwemutengi kana ruzivo rweodha. Vatyairi vanogovera mishumo yekutora chete, senguva yekumirira nedambudziko renzvimbo yekutora.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Kuona kwazvino kunoratidza nzvimbo dzekutora dzechokwadi nenguva yekumirira muMilton Keynes. Kushuma ne{radarPoints} zviri muapp yefoni chete.
